claims.text: May be used for severe alopecia areata in adolescents and adults
claims.quote: Baricitinib, ritlecitinib, and deuruxolitinib are Janus kinase (JAK) inhibitors that may be used for the treatment of severe alopecia areata in adolescents and adults

claims.text: CYP2C9 genetic testing is mandatory before starting deuruxolitinib, to avoid toxicity
claims.quote: Testing for the CYP2C9 gene before treatment with deuruxolitinib is mandatory prior to starting deuruxolitinib to avoid toxicity
